name: MCHub
description:
Welcome to McHub - Your Ultimate Minecraft Adventure!

Dive into a world of endless possibilities on McHub, where three exciting game modes await you:

🏝️ Skyblock

Start with nothing but a tiny island in the sky and build your own empire! Expand your territory, trade with other players, and overcome unique challenges as you rise to become the ultimate Skyblock master.

🌲 Survival

Test your skills in our vast, untamed wilderness. Gather resources, craft tools, and build incredible structures while fending off monsters. Will you thrive or merely survive in this unforgiving landscape?

🔒 Prison

Begin your journey as a lowly inmate and work your way up through the ranks. Mine for valuable resources, complete tasks, and outsmart your fellow prisoners to earn your freedom and become the richest player on the server!

🌟 Features:

Regular events and competitions

Friendly and active community

Dedicated staff team

Custom plugins for enhanced gameplay

Balanced economy system

Anti-cheat protection for fair play

⚡ Performance:

24/7 Uptime

Low latency

High TPS (Ticks Per Second) for smooth gameplay

Join McHub today and embark on your next great Minecraft adventure!
